name: Mitya: Scarf
description:
Namecard style.
Mitya's scarf friend has many wonderful qualities and abilities that ordinary scarves lack. It's sturdier, warmer, more beautiful, and even has a mind of its own. If a rose were more of a rose than any other, then surely its name would be Rose. And so, Mitya's scarf friend is simply named Scarf.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Mitya
